market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. August CPI (imminent) is binary catalyst—hot print triggers Fed hike repricing and bond selloff continuation; cool print stabilizes. Oil remains elevated on Iran. Tech leads but chip divergence (AVGO, CRDO) caps upside. Expect 2-3% VIX spike risk.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle supports 6-12mo equity upside but inflation from energy/geopolitics caps multiples. Bond yields likely 4.5-5.0% range. Selective: infrastructure, power, networking outperform pure semis. Consumer under pressure. EM currencies (NGN, SGD) outperform JPY.
